Stock–recruitment
================================================================================

Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Relationship

```{r}
curves <- tabs$recruitment$curve
pairs <- tabs$recruitment$pairs
plot <- plot_trend(curves, x = ~ssb,
  xlab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(transform(curves, unit = parent_unit), "Parent spawning biomass"),
  ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(curves, "Recruitment"), color = ~model, colors = cols)
plotly::add_markers(plot, data = pairs[!pairs$is_proj, ], x = ~ssb,
                   y = ~recruitment, color = ~model, colors = cols,
                   text = ~paste("Parent year:", parent_year, "Recruitment year:", year),
                   hoverinfo = "text+x+y", inherit = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE)
```

### Predictions

```{r}
plot_trend(tabs$recruitment$prediction, color = ~model, colors = cols,
            ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(tabs$recruitment$prediction, "Conditional recruitment"))
```

### Reference values

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.data.frame(tabs$recruitment$reference)) {
  print(knitr::kable(tabs$recruitment$reference))
} else cat("This curve has no additional recruitment covariates.")
```

Curves show median recruitment at the listed covariate values. Shading shows
uncertainty in the curve, excluding variation in future recruitment. Parent
SSB uses the model's supplied spawning timing; parent and recruitment years are shown on hover.
